option.title: Downloaded Maps Manager
option.description: Stops automatic/on-demand access to downloaded maps. Offline maps and applications that rely on them will stop working.

option.title: Phone Service
option.description: Manages phone/telephony state. Can affect phone integration and VoIP apps that use the Windows telephony service.

option.title: Retail Demo Service
option.description: Used by retail demonstration environments; do not choose on retail/demo devices. Availability is checked on this computer.

option.title: Fax
option.description: Disables fax-device support. Do not choose when Windows Fax or fax peripherals are required.

option.title: Windows Media Player Network Sharing
option.description: Stops sharing Windows Media Player libraries with network media players and DLNA devices. Does not remove the player.

option.title: Geolocation Service
option.description: Location and geofencing APIs stop working; avoid when using maps, Find My Device, location-aware apps or automatic time zone.

option.title: Windows Search indexing
option.description: Disables file and email indexing. Explorer, Start and Outlook searches can become slow or incomplete.

option.title: Connected User Experiences and Telemetry
option.description: Disables Windows diagnostic-telemetry service startup. Device health reporting and managed Endpoint Analytics require this service; do not choose on managed devices.

option.title: Customer Experience Improvement Program - Consolidator
option.description: Disables the installed CEIP consolidation scheduled task, if it exists. Diagnostic participation is reduced; OS security tasks are not touched.

option.title: Customer Experience Improvement Program - USB CEIP
option.description: Stops the installed USB CEIP scheduled task when present, without changing the USB device drivers or hardware configuration.

option.title: Customer Experience Improvement Program - Kernel CEIP
option.description: Disables installed kernel CEIP reporting task, if present. This task is absent on some modern Windows releases.

option.title: Disk Diagnostic Data Collector
option.description: Disables disk diagnostic telemetry collection if present. This may reduce proactive error reporting and has NOT been independently reviewed for every Windows build; opt in only if you accept that limitation.

option.title: Error Reporting - QueueReporting
option.description: Disables queued Windows Error Reporting uploads when the exact task is present. Crash diagnosis/reporting can be affected.

option.title: Maps - automatic map updates
option.description: Stops periodic downloaded-map updates only if the exact Windows Maps task is installed. Offline map content may become stale.

option.title: Maps - map notifications
option.description: Stops background maps notifications when the task exists. Its presence and exact purpose vary with installed Windows Maps components.

option.title: Windows Insider Service
option.description: Stops Windows Insider preview enrollment/update functionality. Avoid on Insider builds or devices participating in test releases.

option.title: Xbox Live Auth Manager
option.description: Xbox Live sign-in and authentication may fail. Avoid when using Xbox services or PC Game Pass games.

option.title: Xbox Live Game Save
option.description: Disables Xbox cloud-game-save synchronization. Avoid if progress must sync with Xbox Live.

option.title: Xbox Live Networking Service
option.description: Breaks the Windows.Networking.XboxLive APIs and can affect Xbox network multiplayer services.

option.title: Xbox Accessory Management
option.description: Xbox accessory management is affected. May interfere with controllers or connected Xbox accessories; do not choose when needed.

option.title: Distributed Link Tracking Client
option.description: Tracking NTFS links between local and networked files may not work. Shortcuts/links to moved documents may not resolve correctly.

option.title: Network Connected Devices Auto-Setup
option.description: Automatic discovery and setup of network-connected devices can stop. Manual device installation is still possible.
